description: Configuration and build script for Linux Kernel tailored for Raspberry Pi within Yocto Project. Contains kernel configuration, build, and deployment logic.

methods.name: kernel_configure_variable
methods.description: Sets kernel configuration variables in the build process.

methods.name: config_setup
methods.description: Prepares the kernel configuration, copying existing configs or defconfig as needed.

methods.name: do_configure_prepend
methods.description: Prepares kernel build configuration, enabling specific features based on machine features and build options.

methods.name: do_compile_append_kirkstone
methods.description: Builds device tree blobs for 64-bit Raspberry Pi kernels during Kirkstone release.

methods.name: do_compile_append_dunfell
methods.description: Builds device tree blobs for 64-bit Raspberry Pi kernels during Dunfell release.

methods.name: do_deploy_append_dunfell
methods.description: Deploys the kernel command line configuration for the main kernel package during Dunfell release.
